info.title: Wildcard API
info.description: The only way into Wildcard’s data. Every JSON body carries a top-level `version`; every failure is an RFC 9457 problem with a stable `reason`.

detail.description: One sentence for people. Never shown as is in the app.

reason.description: The exact failure. Never reworded once released; clients match on it.

errorStatus.description: The general kind of failure, from a fixed list.

id.description: What a 练了 or a planned day sends as `sport`. Never changes, and a sport is never removed.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name. One the phone’s iOS doesn’t have shows a general figure.

offered.description: False for a sport the pickers no longer offer: show it only for check-ins and plans that already name it.

categories.description: The picker’s tabs, in order, each with its sports in order.

signUpCommon.description: Sign-up’s 最常见 grid. Sport ids, in order.

signUpMore.description: Sign-up’s 更多 pills. Sport ids, in order.

checkInQuick.description: A 练了’s quick picks, before the whole list. Sport ids, in order.

picks.description: The short lists some screens show before the whole list.

userId.description: The signed-in member’s Supabase Auth user id.

timeZone.description: The member’s IANA time zone (iOS: `TimeZone.current.identifier`), for their weekly reset.

catchphrase.description: What the member’s character shouts when the squad cheers a teammate’s 练了 (口头禅): 1 to 10 characters on one line, emoji welcome, no links. Null (or left out) until they pick one; the app then uses their persona’s own line. Squadmates read it on the squad’s today.

profile.description: Null until the member first saves one, right after signing up.

nickname.description: What squadmates call the member: 1 to 12 characters on one line, emoji welcome, no links.

Character.description: The member’s character, made in the character editor right after signing in: the nickname squadmates call them and its look. Missing until then.

persona.description: How the character moves (人设), such as `deadpan`.

variants.description: The variant each slot wears, such as `{"body": "peach", "hair": "ponytail"}`. `body` is always there; a slot left out wears the art’s default, or nothing.

colors.description: The swatch a slot is recolored to, for slots in `variants` only. A slot left out keeps its art’s own colors.

Look.description: How a member’s character looks and moves, by the ids of the app’s character art. The API keeps no list of them, so new art needs no API change; an app that doesn’t know an id draws that slot’s default.

appleAuthorizationCode.description: For a member who signed in with Apple: a fresh `authorizationCode` from Sign in with Apple (codes last 5 minutes), so the API can revoke the app’s Apple tokens. Required for an account that signs in with Apple once revocation is set up.

given.description: The member’s latest consent, left out when they never gave one. It may be to an older version.

current.description: True when `given` is to `copyVersion`. Making or joining a squad and AI drafts need it; when false, show that version of the copy and ask.

firstCheckInAt.description: When their first check-in today sent to this squad was made, of any kind, in UTC. Missing when none.

resting.description: Members on a planned rest day with no 练了 or 请假条 today.

everyoneTrained.description: At least one member trained today and every member who did not train is on a planned rest day, whatever they checked in (全员上场).

trainedDays.description: Days this week with a 练了, wherever it was sent. Several on one day count once.

plannedDays.description: Training days in this week’s plan: the y in 本周 x/y.

lifetimeTrainedDays.description: Days ever with a 练了.

plannedDays.description: Training days planned this week, added up over the members’ plans, each in their own week.

language.description: The language the words are in: today `zh-Hans` or `en`. More may come without an app release.

final.description: Every member’s own Sunday is over: the week has been played and the card can show. Numbers can still change after that: a check-in sent up to 48 hours late, a reaction left, changed or taken off later, or a member joining or leaving, since the week is read for the squad as it is now. Before that the week is still being played.

awards.description: The awards someone won this week; one nobody won is left out.

stats.description: Each count added up over the members.

reactions.description: Teammates’ reactions on the week’s check-ins, one entry an emoji someone left, most-used first.

delete.description: Deletes the account and everything that is the member’s: profile, check-ins, photos and squad memberships (squads they made stay with the other members), and revokes Sign in with Apple when given a code. Every member’s day and week are their own, in their time zone; weeks start on Monday, and a member who hasn’t saved a weekly plan has the default one. A member who hasn’t saved a profile yet is read on the signed-in member’s clock. Only for members of the squad.

get.summary: A squad’s week: its awards and counts (周日战报)
get.description: From check-ins sent to the squad by everyone in it now, against their weekly plans. A week runs Monday to Sunday on each member’s own clock, where a day lasts until 3am. Only winners are named and only the signed-in member’s own counts are shown, so nobody is ranked last. Reactions count only from members of the squad now. Any week that has started can be read; until `final`, it is still being played. Only for members of the squad.
